overview: File (1937-38): Japan tolerated the USS Gold Star carrying private cargo Japan-Guam without dues, until the Navy restricted it to government cargo; also covers Yokohama port-clearance rules, an SS Texas inquiry, and an earlier Japanese query on U.S. unopened-port practice.

people.name: Scott

subfiles.about: An index sheet records correspondence on unopened ports, Japanese tonnage dues, the USS GOLD STAR’s carriage of commercial cargo, and the SS TEXAS at Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: Sheet 1: Japan's unopened-port query, the Gold Star's untaxed Guam cargo, Yokohama clearance rules, and an SS Texas inquiry.

interest: Shows a 1937-38 dispute over a U.S. naval ship's commercial cargo and Japanese tonnage dues.
